FS005 熟悉的宝物
安赫瑞尔要塞，城主府内。
文森一脸错愕的看了看阿莱格拉，又看了看坐在上首位的中年人，“阿莱格拉，你爸爸是城主？”
“怎么？我没告诉你吗？”一脸天真却眼中藏着狡黠的阿莱格拉嘻嘻笑了起来。“法师先生，现在告诉你不也是一样嘛！”
“你好！文森－奥古斯丁先生，谢谢救了我的女儿！”中年人，也就是阿莱格拉的父亲，德隆－西兰瑞面带微笑道。
文森不卑不亢道：“德隆城主客气了！我想即使没有我去救阿莱格拉，其他人也会救了她的。”
“哈哈哈哈~”德隆－西兰瑞一笑掩过，并没正面回答。“对了，不知道文森法师家乡在何处？下一步有打算去哪里？”
文森心中冷笑，这就套起自己的底细来。不过，他也并没有生气，德隆是城主，但他也是阿莱格拉的父亲，他有权利知道接近自己女儿的人的底细。
“我的家乡在很遥远的地方，至于具体位置，由于家中规定，不能向外透露啊！”文森歉然道。
德隆心中一动，又想起女儿对他说的文森有很多魔法卷轴的事情，开始胡乱猜想起来。‘莫非他是那些远古世家的子弟？’
‘有些像！拿七级卷轴不当回事的，也只有那些远古世家的子弟了！而且，能够强制七级魔兽签订主从契约的魔法道具，绝对是传说级以上的魔法物品啊！能够拿出这个等级魔法装备的势力，必定是那些远古世家！’
自以为想通之后，德隆又是哈哈一笑的转移了话题。
闲聊了一会之后，城主府内举行了盛大的家宴，招待文森好好的吃了一顿。
饭后，阿莱格拉又跑来找文森，“法师先生，下午我们去逛街好吗？”
“逛街？”文森顿时头痛起来，怎么穿越了，这个世界的女性也喜欢逛街？
“怎么？法师先生不喜欢逛街吗？”阿莱格拉怯怯的看着他。
“走吧走吧，逛街！”
看她那可怜的模样，文森心中一软，答应了下来。
“耶！法师先生真好！”
阿莱格拉眉开眼笑道，丝毫没有刚刚的可怜样。

“呃...上当了！”文森低楠道。
带上身兼五职的疾风贪狼，文森和阿莱格拉漫步在午后的阳光中。
安赫瑞尔要塞临近安赫瑞尔山脉，这座要塞主要的作用是防备北方的兽人部落，地精部落，以及暗黑精灵。
同时，这座要塞的另一个作用便是作为安赫瑞尔山脉物资的交易集中地。
超过九层的冒险队、佣兵团会在安赫瑞尔要塞中处理掉收获，并且停留在这个城市，享受完后又去安赫瑞尔山脉碰运气。
四周的街道人员拥挤，这些拥挤的人群都下意识的避开了拥有疾风贪狼的二人。文森与阿莱格拉并排走在前面，疾风贪狼寸步不落的跟在后面，扮演着忠实的恶仆角色。
看着四周的人群如避蛇蝎，文森很有一种纨绔少爷携恶犬过闹市的小人得志！
“啊！法师先生，你看这个东西好神奇！”
阿莱格拉看着一团白色的软绵绵的东西惊奇道。
“呃...棉花糖？”文森错愕道，‘难道异界也有棉花糖？’
摆摊的是一位十六七岁的少年，稚嫩的脸庞带着一股献媚，“尊贵的魔法师大人，这是白云果，口感十分好，而且只要一银币一个！”
“法师先生，我想要这个白云果！”阿莱格拉两眼冒星星道，她从小在城主府内，很少出来。
即使出来，也是一群人前呼后拥的，根本无法享受逛街的乐趣！
“嗯，那就买了吧！”文森拿起这个与棉花糖别无二致的白云果递给阿莱格拉，然后自己也拿来一个。
“主人，我，吃！”
一个硕大的狼头，突然伸到文森面前，疾风贪狼流着口水的看着白云果。疾风贪狼之所以叫贪狼，原因就在于它十分贪吃，只要是能吃的东西，它都想尝试一下。
“拿去吧！”文森丢了一个白云果去，疾风贪狼大嘴一张，将人头大小的白云果一口吞下后，又看向摊位上其他的白云果。
“吃货！”文森笑骂了一句，然后道：“全部买了！小兄弟，你把这些白云果丢给我的坐骑吃。”
“啊？”少年胆颤心惊的看着疾风贪狼，脸上神色变幻不定。最后，咽了一口口水，大着胆子拿起白云果向疾风贪狼抛去。
摊位上二十多个白云果转瞬之间被疾风贪狼吃完，它这才心满意足的退下。

“尊贵的魔法师大人，您的坐骑吃了二十六个白云果，加上您和尊贵的小姐一人一个，一共是两枚金币八枚银币。”喂完疾风贪狼，少年摸了一把冷汗，恭敬道。
“呃...”文森突然想起来，他似乎没有钱！
转头看向阿莱格拉，显然这个城主之女也不像带钱的人。于是道：“我没金币啊！”
“啊？”少年错愕的看着文森，显然十分十分的惊诧啊！
“我真的没有金币！”文森无可奈何的苦笑，“阿莱格拉？”
阿莱格拉无辜的看向文森，“法师先生，你以为呢？”
“尊贵的魔法师大人，您不会不付钱吧？”少年脸色涨红起来。
文森想了想，从无尽之空里拿出一个卷轴，递向少年道：“这是七级魔法卷轴，土系泥沼术，应该能抵消两金币吧？”
“七级魔法卷轴？”四周看热闹的人群中发出一阵惊讶，随即用火热的眼光看向卷轴。
少年人同样目光火热的看向卷轴，最后却摇头道：“尊贵的魔法师大人，七级魔法卷轴价值太高，还请您收回！”
“哦？”文森从周围人群的反映，得知七级魔法卷轴的价值应该很高，这个少年人的品性倒是不错。
“那这个呢？”他又拿出一颗四级魔兽的魔兽晶核，这是无尽之空内，等级最低的物品了！
“尊贵的魔法师大人，这个也价值太高！”少年人憋红了脸道。
“可是，这是我最不值钱的东西了，你不要它，我没有其他东西可以给你了！”文森耸了耸肩。
“这...”少年人迟疑起来，那二十多颗白云果是他全部家产，如果真被吃了霸王餐，他的下一顿只有喝风去。
“少年，收下吧！这位法师先生可不在乎那东西呢！”阿莱格拉笑眯眯道，一双眼睛眯成了弯月。
“谢谢尊贵的魔法师大人赏赐！”少年接过魔兽晶核，低头感激道。
告别了少年后，文森与阿莱格拉一起走向安赫瑞尔要塞的交易市场，阿莱格拉说想去看看。
交易市场内，人山人海，各种吆喝声、砍价声不绝于耳。才走进交易市场门口，文森又一次感觉到那股熟悉的魔法波动！

content_en:
FS005 Familiar Treasure
Angelil Fortress, inside the city lord's palace.
Vincent looked at Allegra in astonishment, then at the middle-aged man sitting in the first place, "Allegra, is your father the city lord?"
"What? Didn't I tell you?" Allegra, who looked innocent but had cunning in his eyes, laughed. "Mr. Master, I'm telling you now, isn't it the same thing?"
"Hello! Mr. Vincent-Augustin, thank you for saving my daughter!" the middle-aged man, Allegra's father, Delon Silanry said with a smile.
Vincent said neither humble nor arrogantly: "Lord Delong, you are so polite! I think even if I didn't save Allegra, others would have saved her."
"Hahahaha~" Delon Xilanrui smiled and did not answer directly. "By the way, I wonder where Master Vincent's hometown is? Where do you plan to go next?"
Vincent sneered in his heart, and then tried to hide his own details. However, he was not angry. Delon was the city lord, but he was also Allegra's father. He had the right to know the details of the people who were close to his daughter.
"My hometown is in a very far away place. As for the specific location, due to family regulations, it cannot be disclosed to the outside world!" Vincent said apologetically.
Delong's heart moved, and he remembered what his daughter told him about Vincent having many magic scrolls, and began to make random guesses. ‘Could he be a descendant of those ancient families? ’
‘Something like it! The only ones who don't take the seventh-level scroll seriously are the children of the ancient aristocratic families! Moreover, a magic item that can force a seventh-level monster to sign a master-slave contract is definitely a magic item above the legendary level! The forces that can produce magic equipment of this level must be those ancient aristocratic families! ’
After thinking he had figured it out, Deron laughed and changed the subject.
After chatting for a while, a grand family banquet was held in the city lord's palace, and Vincent was treated to a good meal.
After the meal, Allegra came to Vincent again, "Mr. Master, can we go shopping in the afternoon?"
"Shopping?" Vincent suddenly had a headache. Why did he travel through time? Women in this world also like to go shopping?
"What? Mr. Wizard, don't you like shopping?" Allegra looked at him timidly.
"Let's go, let's go shopping!"
Seeing her pitiful appearance, Vincent felt soft and agreed.
"Yeah! Mr. Master is so kind!"
Allegra said with a wide-eyed smile, not at all pitiful as before.
"Uh... I was fooled!" Vincent said.
Taking the five-person Gale Greedy Wolf with them, Vincent and Allegra walked in the afternoon sunshine.
Angelil Fortress is located near the Angelil Mountains. The main function of this fortress is to defend against the orc tribes, goblin tribes, and dark elves in the north.
At the same time, another function of this fortress is to serve as a trading center for supplies in the Angelil Mountains.
Adventure teams and mercenary groups that exceed the ninth level will dispose of their harvest in Angelil Fortress, stay in this city, and then go to the Angelil Mountains to try their luck after enjoying themselves.
The surrounding streets were crowded with people, and these crowded people subconsciously avoided the two people who possessed the Gale of Wind and Greedy Wolf. Vincent and Allegra walked side by side in front, while Gale and Greedy Wolf followed closely behind, playing the role of loyal evil servants.
Seeing the crowds around him as if they were avoiding snakes and scorpions, Vincent felt like a naughty young master carrying a vicious dog through a busy city and succeeding!
"Ah! Mr. Master, look at this thing, it's so magical!"
Allegra looked at a white soft thing and said in surprise.
"Uh...marshmallows?" Vincent asked in astonishment, "Could there be marshmallows in other worlds?" ’
The person setting up the stall was a sixteen or seventeen-year-old boy, with a hint of flattery on his immature face, "Dear Master Magician, these are white cloud fruits. They taste very good, and they only cost one silver coin each!"
"Mr. Master, I want this White Cloud Fruit!" Allegra's eyes were filled with stars.Xingdao, she has been in the city lord's mansion since she was a child and rarely comes out.
Even if you come out, you will still be surrounded by a group of people, and you will not be able to enjoy the fun of shopping at all!
"Well, let's buy it then!" Vincent picked up the white cloud fruit, which was no different from a marshmallow, and handed it to Allegra, and then took one himself.
"Master, I, eat!"
A huge wolf head suddenly stretched out in front of Vincent. Gale Greedy Wolf looked at Baiyun Guo with drooling eyes. The reason why Gale Greedy Wolf is called Greedy Wolf is because it is very greedy and wants to try anything that is edible.
"Take it!" Vincent threw a white cloud fruit. Gale Feng Tan Lang opened his mouth and swallowed the head-sized white cloud fruit in one gulp, then looked at the other white cloud fruits on the stall.
"Foodie!" Vincent cursed with a smile, and then said: "I bought them all! Little brother, throw these white cloud fruits to my mount."
"Ah?" The young man looked at Gale Greedy Wolf with fear, the expression on his face changing. Finally, after swallowing a sip of saliva, he boldly picked up the white cloud fruit and threw it towards Gale Greedy Wolf.
More than twenty white cloud fruits on the stall were eaten by Gale Wind Greedy Wolf in an instant, and then he retired with satisfaction.
"Distinguished Lord Magician, your mount has eaten twenty-six white cloud fruits, plus one for you and the distinguished lady, a total of two gold coins and eight silver coins." After feeding Gale Greedy Wolf, the young man touched it with cold sweat and said respectfully.
"Uh..." Vincent suddenly remembered that he seemed to have no money!
Turning to look at Allegra, it was obvious that the daughter of the city lord did not look like someone with money. So he said: "I don't have any gold coins!"
"Ah?" The young man looked at Vincent in astonishment, obviously very surprised!
"I really don't have any gold coins!" Vincent smiled helplessly, "Allegra?"
Allegra looked at Vincent innocently, "Mr. Mage, what do you think?"
"Dear Master Magician, you won't refuse to pay, will you?" The young man's face turned red.
Vincent thought for a while, took out a scroll from the endless sky, handed it to the young man and said: "This is a seventh-level magic scroll, an earth-type quagmire technique. It should be able to offset two gold coins, right?"
"Seventh level magic scroll?" There was a burst of surprise among the crowd watching around, and then they looked at the scroll with fiery eyes.
The young man also looked at the scroll with fiery eyes, but finally shook his head and said: "Dear magician, the value of the seventh-level magic scroll is too high, please take it back!"
"Oh?" Vincent learned from the reactions of the people around him that the value of the seventh-level magic scroll should be very high, and that this young man had a good character.
"What about this?" He took out another level 4 magic beast crystal core. This is the lowest level item in the Endless Sky!
"Dear Master Magician, this is too valuable!" the young man said while suppressing his blush.
"But this is my least valuable thing. If you don't want it, I have nothing else to give you!" Vincent shrugged.
"This..." The young man hesitated. The more than twenty white cloud fruits were his entire family property. If he was really eaten, his next meal would be to drink the wind.
"Young man, take it! This mage doesn't care about that thing!" Allegra said with a smile, her eyes narrowed into crescent moons.
"Thank you, distinguished Master Magician, for the reward!" The young man took the World of Warcraft crystal core and bowed his head in gratitude.
After bidding farewell to the boy, Vincent and Allegra walked towards the trading market of Angelil Fortress. Allegra said she wanted to take a look.
The trading market is crowded with people, and there are endless shouts and bargaining sounds. Just after walking into the entrance of the trading market, Vincent once again felt the familiar magic wave!
